arabic text: NIKLA HAI JANAZA KOI ALLAH KE GHAR SE
english translation text: A COFFIN HAS EMERGED FROM THE HOUSE OF ALLAH

arabic text: AFLAK MEIN IK SHOOR HAI MATAM KE ASAR SE
english translation text: THE SKIES ARE ALSO WAILING FROM THE EFFECT OF ITS MOURNING

arabic text: AFOOS KEH MASJID MEIN NAMAZI GIYA MARA.\nKUCH KAM NAHI YEH MEHSHAR QAYAMAT KE ASAR SE
english translation text: SO SAD A WORSHIPPER OF ALLAH GOT KILLED IN THE MOSQUE\nIT IS NO LESS THAN EFFECT OF THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT

arabic text: ZAINAB(SA) SE YEH KEH DO KEH WOH DIL KHOL KE ROYE\nSHABIR(AS) KI HAMSHEER HAI RONE KO NA TARSE.
english translation text: PLEASE TELL ZAINAB TO CRY AND MOURN OPENLY\nSHE’S SHABBIR’S SISTER, SHE SHOULD NOT BE DEPRIVED FROM MOURNING

arabic text: ABBAS(AS) ZARA ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR(AS) SE KHABARDAR.\nFARYAD MEIN HAT JAYE NA CHADAR KAHIN SAR SE.
english translation text: ABBAS PLEASE BEWARE OF ZAINAB, THE GRIEVED,\nSEE THAT HER HIJAB STAYS WHILE SHE MOURNS

arabic text: HAN BHOL NA JANA INHEIN KOFE KE MAKEENO.\nGUZREIN GEIN YEH SHEHZADIYAAN ISS RAH GUZAR SE.
english translation text: DO NOT FORGET THEM, OH, THE RESIDENTS OF KUFA\nTHESE PRINCESSES WILL PASS BY THESE STREETS

arabic text: SHABIR(AS) KO YAAD AA GAYI KHUD APNI SAKINA(SA).\nZAINAB(SA) KO HATAYA GIYA JAB LASH PADAR SE.
english translation text: SHABBIR RECALLED HIS OWN DAUGHTER, SAKINA\nWHEN ZAINAB WAS BEING FORCEFULLY REMOVED FROM HER FATHER’S CORPSE

arabic text: YAAD AA GIYA ZAINAB(SA) KO WOH PEHLU-E-SHAKISTA.\nROOMAL HATAYA GIYA BABA KE JO SAR SE..
english translation text: ZAINAB RECALLED HER MOTHER’S BROKEN RIB\nWHEN THE CLOTH WAS REMOVED FROM HER FATHER’S HEAD
